5:04 p.m. Weather conditions: air temperature 70 degrees, relative humidity 59 percent, barometer 29.96 inches, adjusted altitude 1,877 feet.

Gadson gets a great light but it isn't enough to take the win.

Van Sant is a little too quick off of the line and goes red.

Herrera goes down the groove with the quickest pass of the quad and takes the win. This is Herrera's 29th career win.

Gaige Herrera's incremental times: 60ft-1.052 sec., 330ft-2.824, 660ft-4.326/162.96 mph, 1,000ft-5.637. 

Howey makes a decent pass but comes in third.


Finish Order & Margins: 1. Gaige Herrera was 0.0404 sec./about 12 feet ahead of 2. Richard Gadson, who was 0.047 sec./about 14 feet ahead of 3. Clayton Howey, who was Green ahead of 4.
